Maruti Suzuki Increases Prices Across All Car Models

Maruti Suzuki has raised the prices of all its car models, including the Dzire, new Brezza, Ertiga, and Fronx. The price hike affects vehicles ranging from the Alto K10 to the Vitara. Specific details on the extent of the price increase for each model were not provided in the coverage.
